_description: Frozen benchmark parameters for the Local Index (L1) vs Shared Index (S1) OpenSearch experiment. Written once calibration was complete; do not edit after the formal 18 runs begin — cut a new file/commit instead so historical runs stay traceable to the parameters that produced them.

shared_index.label: S1
shared_index.notes: Logical compute/storage disaggregation using OpenSearch remote-backed storage; os-s1-data and os-s1-search are co-located containers, not physically independent infrastructure.

query_set.notes: Fixed set, never filtered based on OpenSearch hit results; reused unmodified across all systems and workloads.

query_qps_check.verdict: both L1 and S1 sustained ~50.01 QPS with 0 errors/timeouts and no saturation signal over 60s; locked without dropping to 25

write_docs_per_s_check.verdict: S1 sustained 496.35 docs/s (99.3% of target) at 50 QPS concurrent read load, 0 write errors/rejections, thread_pool.write.rejected stayed at 0 with no queue growth; locked at 500 without a 400 docs/s retry
